verdict.rationale: Twenty ships an official CLI with a dedicated docs page. It scaffolds apps (`npx create-twenty-app`), live-syncs source changes with a `dev` command, and publishes apps (`npx twenty app:publish --private`), letting objects, fields and views be defined as code. Its documented scope is app development, not general CRM operation. Missing for 10: CLI commands for querying or mutating CRM records and workspace data, AI- or agent-oriented CLI workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
